corrects.what_was_wrong: the protocol's Gate 1 used a single CONSTANT-weight ceiling and proposed to stop the programme when it showed no detectable headroom. A constant weight vector cannot express a gate, so that ceiling does not bound contextual fusion, and the rule would have discarded the hypothesis it was meant to test.
corrects.what_replaces_it: four ceilings, of which the per-individual CONVEX one bounds the whole family; a verdict rule in which an interval containing zero is a non-detection and refutation requires the upper bound to fall below a declared minimum interesting gain; weights fitted on one partition and scored on another; and a context probe that can refute contextual fusion independently of any ceiling.

proof_that_the_correction_matters.what_this_proves: A constant-weight ceiling can show exactly zero headroom on a cohort where a contextual gate is perfect. Stopping the programme on the constant-weight ceiling alone would have discarded the hypothesis it was meant to test.

constant_weight_oracle.bounds: constant-weight mixtures only: stacking and uniform averaging. It does NOT bound a contextual gate.

individual_convex_oracle.bounds: EVERY method in the family, contextual gates included. A gap of zero here refutes the family.
individual_convex_oracle.why_it_cannot_guide: it is zero wherever the arms bracket the truth, so with several arms it is usually small and usually permissive. Use it to refute, never to promise.

not_evaluated.hlc_h2a_arms: The eight H2a arms are stored as LOSSES, not per-donor predictions, so their convex ceiling cannot be recomputed from the frozen artefacts. The four arms used here come from hlc_real_cyp_validation with its own designs, folds, model and seed unchanged. Extending the diagnostic to the H2a arms means re-running them to retain predictions, which is a separate job and still not a Fusing implementation.

what_this_run_does_not_do.ceilings_are_not_performances: every ceiling here is computed knowing the answers and is an upper bound on what any honest method could reach. None may be quoted as a result.
what_this_run_does_not_do.a_permissive_ceiling_licenses_nothing: the per-individual convex ceiling is zero wherever the arms bracket the truth. It can refute; it cannot promise.
what_this_run_does_not_do.non_detection_is_not_refutation: an interval containing zero yields NO_DETECTABLE_HEADROOM_UNDERPOWERED, never a refutation.
